open_points: HSI contract is NOT_PROVIDED in the manifest, creating a gap in traceability as per upstream_gaps.md.

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: target_robot_test passes when no IWDG register writes occur before any LL function call

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall ensure that a write operation affects only the named bits within a register.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when write operations modify only specified bits in target registers
